name: FED-Alpha 335/65 R22.5 at 60 psi
source: Project Chrono vehicle data (https://github.com/projectchrono/chrono, pinned commit e166f3e5a1383741e86cf1e195a46eba4a66473d). Chrono publishes model parameters with its examples, not measurements: some are estimates or placeholders (docs/chrono-data.md lists what was found).
notes: One of four inflation pressures of the same tyre. Exported by a fitting tool (header: FM_EXPORT_TIR, MF-TYRE 5.0, 2010); its RAW_FILES field is empty, so the data it was fitted from is not identified.
